meta.title: Asian Doula Alliance: doula certification, exams and the ADA registry
meta.description: Asian Doula Alliance certifies postpartum and birth doulas, runs the ADA written and practical exam, and keeps a public registry anyone can check for free.

hero.title: Become an <nw>ADA-certified</nw> doula.
hero.line: ADA training and exams are offered in {languages}.
hero.imageAlt: Four trainees in the ADA Postpartum Doula Program practise holding a newborn, using training dolls

registry.title: Check that a doula is <nw>ADA-certified</nw>
registry.body: Every ADA certificate has a public, dated record. It shows whether the credential is active today and lists any suspension or revocation.
registry.exampleLong: Look up a record by certificate number, Doula ID or full name, for example <nw>{cert}</nw>, <nw>{id}</nw> or {name}.
registry.counts: As of {date}: {doulas, number} {doulas, plural, one {doula} other {doulas}} with an active credential · {certificates, number} {certificates, plural, one {certificate} other {certificates}} issued

postpartum.validityValue: Valid for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}

birth.title: ADA Birth Doula
birth.description: Labor and delivery support. Cohorts run on a rolling basis.

education.title: ADA Education
education.description: The ADA curriculum, taught by ADA Certified Trainers and Approved Training Providers.

examDay.title: What to expect on exam day
examDay.imageAlt: Four candidates write the ADA written exam at spaced desks
examDay.caption: The written exam: one candidate to a desk. August 2024.
examDay.practicalValue: {minutes} minutes, one-on-one with an ADA examiner.
examDay.resultsValue: By email in about {days} business days. The pass mark is {pass}/{max}.

families.title: For families
families.body: Hiring a doula? Check the doula's public ADA record first. It shows whether the credential is active today.

insurers.title: For insurers and agencies
insurers.body: ADA certification is recognized by {insurers}. Anyone can check a doula's credential in the ADA registry, free of charge.

about.title: About ADA
about.whatDescription: A California nonprofit that sets the curriculum, examines candidates and keeps the registry.
about.governanceDescription: The ADA board of directors, and how board members are elected.
about.conductDescription: The principles every ADA-certified doula agrees to. Violations can lead to suspension or revocation.
about.providersDescription: Teach the ADA curriculum as an ADA Certified Trainer or an Approved Training Provider.
about.contactDescription: Questions about the exam, the registry or your record: {email}
